description: This file contains implementation of ASN.1 message structures and methods related to 5G NR RRC paging messages, including packing, unpacking, JSON serialization, and class methods for handling paging-related data structures.

classes.name: group_paging_r18_s
classes.description: Represents the GroupPaging-r18 ASN.1 sequence with a boolean flag for inactive reception.

classes.name: paging_ue_id_c
classes.description: Represents the PagingUE-Identity ASN.1 CHOICE with methods to set, get, serialize, and destroy different identity types.

classes.name: paging_record_s
classes.description: Represents the PagingRecord ASN.1 sequence with fields for UE identity and access type.

classes.name: paging_record_v1700_s
classes.description: Represents the PagingRecord-v1700 ASN.1 sequence with paging cause information.

classes.name: paging_record_v1800_s
classes.description: Represents the PagingRecord-v1800 ASN.1 sequence with a flag for MT-SDT.

classes.name: paging_v1800_ies_s
classes.description: Represents the Paging-v1800-IEs ASN.1 sequence containing lists of paging records and groups.

classes.name: paging_v1700_ies_s
classes.description: Represents the Paging-v1700-IEs ASN.1 sequence containing lists of paging records and groups.

classes.name: paging_s
classes.description: Represents the top-level Paging ASN.1 sequence with lists of paging records and extensions.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the ASN.1 structure into a bit_ref buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the ASN.1 structure from a bit_ref buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the structure into JSON format.

methods.name: destroy_
methods.description: Destroys the current choice in the paging_ue_id_c class.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the identity type and initializes the corresponding data.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying paging_ue_id_c objects.

methods.name: set_ng_5_g_s_tmsi
methods.description: Sets the identity to ng-5G-S-TMSI and returns the bitstring reference.

methods.name: set_full_i_rnti
methods.description: Sets the identity to fullI-RNTI and returns the bitstring reference.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts the identity type enum to string.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts the identity type enum to a number.
